title: 纽约大学教授：AI或成有缺陷的工具
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Give us a flavor to kick us off of your view of where we are now.
segments.zh: 先谈谈你对当前形势的看法。

segments.en: And when you hear people like Rishi Sunak talk about the next industrial revolution, what is your reaction?
segments.zh: 听到苏纳克等人谈论下一次工业革命，你作何反应？

segments.en: I mean AI could be the next industrial revolution, but the industrial revolution raised productivity.
segments.zh: AI可能是下一次工业革命，但工业革命提高了生产率。

segments.en: And so far AI has not really done that. There's been a lot of promises.
segments.zh: 而到目前为止，AI并未真正实现这一点。有很多承诺。

segments.en: When ChachiBT came out, there were stories about how it was going to 10X everything.
segments.zh: ChatGPT问世时，有报道称它将使一切效率提升十倍。

segments.en: There were going to be a lot of billion dollar companies with one employee.
segments.zh: 将出现许多只有一名员工的十亿美元公司。

segments.en: It hasn't 10X things that was yet another study yesterday showing that it's hard to find measurable impact of AI.
segments.zh: 它并未使效率提升十倍，昨天还有研究显示很难找到AI的可衡量影响。

segments.en: That was not true in the industrial revolution, although you could ask how long did it play out.
segments.zh: 工业革命时期并非如此，尽管你可以问它持续了多久。

segments.en: We may eventually have AI 10Xing people, but I don't think we will with a current technology.
segments.zh: 我们最终可能让AI使人们效率提升十倍，但我认为当前技术做不到。

segments.en: I think one thing outsiders don't understand is AI is actually a whole grab bag of different technologies.
segments.zh: 我认为外界不了解的一点是，AI实际上是各种技术的集合。

segments.en: Most of the work right now is on large language models.
segments.zh: 目前大部分工作都集中在大型语言模型上。

segments.en: But large language models, which I joke the other day, might soon be called large liability modules.
segments.zh: 但大型语言模型，我前几天开玩笑说，可能很快会被叫做大型责任模块。

segments.en: Because they're not very well constrained.
segments.zh: 因为它们没有受到很好的约束。

segments.en: They don't really follow instructions. And for most business applications, if you have an intern that doesn't follow instructions, you fire them.
segments.zh: 它们并不真正遵循指令。对于大多数商业应用来说，如果你的实习生不遵循指令，你会解雇他们。

segments.en: LLMs don't really follow instructions. All the so-called rogue AI things are examples of that, where they're not really following instructions.
segments.zh: 大型语言模型并不真正遵循指令。所有所谓的流氓AI事件都是例子，它们并不真正遵循指令。

segments.en: They're following loosely. If you told an employee, hey, do really well on this exam.
segments.zh: 它们只是松散地遵循。如果你告诉员工，嘿，这次考试要考好。
